directionReason: A neighbourhood bakery should feel warm and generous, and the hot orange reads like a fresh crust.
metaTitle: Crumb & Co. · Sourdough bakery in Fitzroy
metaDescription: A concept site for Crumb & Co., a neighbourhood sourdough bakery in Fitzroy with a weekend pre-order.

hero.headline: Bread worth getting up for
hero.sub: Naturally leavened loaves, laminated pastries and a weekend pre-order, so the good stuff is waiting for you.

statement: We bake *one batch a day*, from flour milled in Victoria, and stop when it runs out.

services.title: What comes out of the oven
services.intro: A short menu, made properly every morning.

items.title: Sourdough
items.body: Country white, seeded rye and a dark spelt, fermented for 36 hours and baked hard for a crackling crust.

items.title: Pastry
items.body: Croissants, cardamom knots and a rotating danish, laminated by hand the afternoon before.

items.title: Weekend pre-order
items.body: Order by Thursday night and your bag is packed and waiting at the counter on Saturday morning.

showcase.title: Thirty-six hours, start to crust
showcase.body: Slow fermentation is where the flavour comes from, and why our loaves keep for days.
points: Baked in a deck oven every morning

items.title: Choose
items.body: Pick your loaves and pastries online by Thursday at 9pm.

items.title: We bake
items.body: Your order goes into Saturday's first bake.

items.title: Collect
items.body: Skip the queue and pick up your bag from 7am.

items.a: Thursday at 9pm for Saturday pick-up. After that, come in early and try your luck.
Not yet. Our kitchen handles flour all day, so we would rather not promise what we can't guarantee.

items.q: Can I order for an event?
items.a: Yes, with a week's notice. Ask at the counter and we will work out quantities with you.
At the counter on Brunswick Street. Pre-orders have their own shelf, so there's no queue.

cta.headline: Saturday's bake is filling up
cta.body: Pre-orders close Thursday night. Reserve your loaf and it'll be waiting.
